description: The climbing trail to access Hail Merry and also a great beginner descent. No TTFs but the infamous "Cliff Hanger" bridge is something that needs to be seen. The climb is quite strenuous with lots of challenging switchbacks and a fairly consistent grade that doesn't offer much chance for recovery. The descent provides a good challenge to an unconfident beginner rider while still being a smooth fast twisty ride for the more skilled riders. For detailed trail info, this can be found on Trail Forks.
directions: From the junction of Highway 3 and 22, at the overpass in Castlegar, travel west towards Grand Forks for 3 km. Turn right onto a good 2 wheel drive dirt road marked "Merry Creek Forest Service Road". Proceed approximately 2 km to the parking lot. Here there is a kiosk and signage with importation on all the biking trails in the Merry Creek area.
title: Merry Go Around Trail
